customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile

customer_type.meaning: individual consumer, or business customer (fleet lessee or dealership)

name.meaning: individual's full legal name, or the business's legal name, exactly as on the profile

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number on the profile

tax_id_last4.meaning: last four digits of the individual's Social Security number, or of the business's EIN

date_of_birth.meaning: individual's date of birth; empty for a business

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the billing address on the profile

mailing_address.meaning: billing/mailing address on the profile, exactly as recorded

customer_since.meaning: date the customer's first Kestrel account was opened

authorized_signer_name.meaning: for a business, the authorized signer named on the master agreement; empty for an individual

bankruptcy_status.meaning: bankruptcy status recorded by the bankruptcy unit; none when no filing is known

retail_contract_id.meaning: primary id of the contract record

account_number.meaning: 10-digit account number printed on the contract and monthly statements, stated by callers as read from their statement

variant_name.meaning: the tier held, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the contract (basis defined in the category charter lifecycle)

vin.meaning: 17-character vehicle identification number of the financed vehicle

vehicle_year.meaning: model year of the financed vehicle

vehicle_model.meaning: make, model and trim of the financed vehicle as printed on the contract

contract_state.meaning: US state whose law governs the contract (the state of the selling dealer)

contract_date.meaning: date the retail installment sale contract was signed at the dealer

first_payment_date.meaning: due date of the first scheduled installment

maturity_date.meaning: due date of the final scheduled installment; moves later when installments are extended

term_months.meaning: original number of monthly installments in the contract

apr.meaning: annual percentage rate of the contract; simple interest accrues daily on the principal balance at this rate

amount_financed.meaning: amount financed disclosed on the contract

due_day.meaning: day of the month on which each installment falls due

next_due_date.meaning: due date of the oldest installment not yet fully paid, as of the last nightly cycle

days_past_due.meaning: calendar days the oldest unpaid installment is past its due date as of the last nightly cycle; 0 when current

past_due_amount.meaning: sum of unpaid installment amounts whose due dates have passed, as of the last nightly cycle; excludes fees

principal_balance.meaning: current unpaid principal; identically the sum of the principal_balance account deltas

fees_due_balance.meaning: current unpaid fees; identically the sum of the fees_due account deltas

interest_paid_to_date.meaning: date through which simple interest has been paid; per-diem interest accrues from the day after this date

last_payment_date.meaning: posting date of the most recent payment; empty if none yet

payments_made_count.meaning: number of scheduled installments satisfied to date

extensions_used_lifetime.meaning: total number of installments deferred by extensions over the life of the contract

last_extension_date.meaning: effective date of the most recent extension; empty if never extended

due_date_changes_used.meaning: number of due-date changes made over the life of the contract

last_due_date_change_date.meaning: effective date of the most recent due-date change; empty if never changed

late_charge_max_amount.meaning: maximum late charge per installment permitted under the governing state's law for this contract, recorded at booking

nsf_fee_max_amount.meaning: maximum returned-payment fee permitted under the governing state's law for this contract, recorded at booking; 0.00 where none may be charged

extension_fee_permitted.meaning: whether the governing state's law permits an extension fee on this contract, recorded at booking

right_to_cure_days.meaning: days a right-to-cure notice must run before repossession may be assigned under the governing state's law, recorded at booking; 0 where no notice is required

state_reinstatement_days.meaning: days after repossession during which the governing state's law grants a right to reinstate, recorded at booking; 0 where the state grants none

nois_min_days.meaning: minimum calendar days between mailing the notice of intent to sell and the sale under the governing state's law, recorded at booking

right_to_cure_notice_date.meaning: date the right-to-cure notice was mailed; empty if none mailed

repo_assigned_date.meaning: date the account was assigned to a repossession agency; empty if never assigned

repossession_date.meaning: date the vehicle was recovered or surrendered; empty if not repossessed

repossession_type.meaning: how the vehicle came back into the company's possession; none if never repossessed

nois_mailed_date.meaning: date the notice of intent to sell was mailed; empty if none mailed

scheduled_sale_date.meaning: auction date set for the repossessed vehicle; empty if none scheduled

reinstatements_used.meaning: number of times this contract has been reinstated after repossession

lien_type.meaning: how the lien is recorded with the title state: elt = electronic lien and title, paper = paper title held by the company

title_state.meaning: state in which the vehicle is titled

title_status.meaning: status of the company's lien on the vehicle title

autopay_enrolled.meaning: whether recurring automatic ACH payments are enrolled

certified_funds_only_until.meaning: last date of a certified-funds-only restriction imposed after returned payments; empty if no restriction

paid_in_full_date.meaning: date the balance reached zero; empty while a balance remains

closed_date.meaning: date the account was closed after lien release; empty while open

retail_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the transaction record

retail_contract_id.meaning: owning contract (foreign key -> the contract record)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the category charter

txn_date.meaning: date the transaction posted (for notices, the mailing date; for quotes, the quote date)

amount.meaning: amount of this transaction, always positive; the account and direction are given by the event type; 0.00 for notices

payment_channel.meaning: channel through which money was received or refunded; not_applicable for non-cash events

funding_account_last4.meaning: last four digits of the bank account or debit card the payment was drawn from, as stated by the payer; empty when not applicable

payment_purpose.meaning: what the payment was taken to accomplish; not_applicable for non-payment events

interest_applied.meaning: portion of a payment applied to accrued simple interest

principal_applied.meaning: portion of a payment applied to principal

fees_applied.meaning: portion of a payment applied to fees due

convenience_fee.meaning: channel fee collected on top of the payment; 0.00 when none

reversed_txn_id.meaning: for a returned payment or returned-payment fee, the payment transaction that was dishonoured

return_reason.meaning: reason the bank returned the payment; not_applicable otherwise

payment_txn_id.meaning: for a fee payment, the payment transaction from which the fee portion was applied

installment_due_date.meaning: due date of the specific installment a late charge, extension or due-date change relates to

fee_type.meaning: kind of fee assessed, paid or waived

waived_txn_id.meaning: for a fee waiver, the specific fee transaction being waived

waiver_reason.meaning: controlled reason for a fee waiver

old_due_day.meaning: due day before a due-date change

new_due_day.meaning: due day after a due-date change

installments_deferred.meaning: number of installments moved to the end of the term by an extension

good_faith_amount.meaning: good-faith payment received before an extension was granted; 0.00 when none was required

quote_good_through_date.meaning: last date on which a payoff quote's amount is honoured

per_diem.meaning: daily simple interest stated on a payoff quote

quote_purpose.meaning: for whom and why a payoff quote was produced

release_recipient.meaning: party who receives the released title or lien release

mailing_address_type.meaning: where a paper title was mailed

care_contract_id.meaning: for a refund credit, the Kestrel Care contract whose cancellation refund is applied

service_days.meaning: number of storage days billed by a storage fee; 0 for other events

gross_proceeds.meaning: gross auction sale price of a repossessed vehicle

sale_expenses.meaning: auction and reconditioning expenses deducted from the gross proceeds

property_release_type.meaning: how personal property found in a repossessed vehicle was released

retail_request_id.meaning: primary id of the customer-signature request

retail_contract_id.meaning: contract the request relates to (foreign key -> the contract record)

request_type.meaning: kind of request that needs the customer's own signature or action before it takes effect

request_status.meaning: status of the request: awaiting_customer until the customer signs or acts, then completed

requested_installments.meaning: for an extension agreement, the number of installments to be deferred; 0 otherwise

alternate_address.meaning: for a title release to an alternate address, the mailing address exactly as the customer states it; empty otherwise

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS with zone)

completed_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS with zone) or empty
